variables.name: DEFAULT_HOSTNAMES
variables.description: Comma-separated hostnames treated as factory defaults. The check fails when the hostname is in this list.

variables.name: WIFI_ENCRYPTION
variables.description: Comma-separated approved wireless encryption modes. Remediation writes the first token unless XM_REMEDIATE_WIFI_ENC is set.

variables.name: SSH_WAN_PORT
variables.description: Destination port treated as WAN SSH. The check fails when the firewall accepts it from WAN.

variables.name: PORT_FORWARD_MAX
variables.description: Maximum firewall redirects that still pass. The check fails above this count.

variables.name: LAN_FACTORY_PREFIX
variables.description: Factory LAN address prefix. The check fails when network.lan.ipaddr starts with it.

variables.name: PMF_VALUES
variables.description: Comma-separated ieee80211w values accepted as PMF. Remediation writes the first token.

variables.name: WEAK_ADMIN_PASSWORDS
variables.description: Comma-separated admin password markers. The check fails when a password field equals one of them.
